sources.title: Warsaw General Confederation 28 January 1573, signed parchment AGAD 4467
sources.verificationNote: AGAD archive parchment 4467. Official PL transcription protects dissidentes de religione from persecution yet preserves lord's power over subjects in spiritualibus/saecularibus. Seal count correction RESOLVED: original 2010 AGAD inventory 206 bowls/six rows; conservator Justyna Król-Próba's 2016 work and published article pp709-715 renumbered 1-209 and demonstrated 209 bowls/seven rows. AGAD later page gives 181 imprints/27 blanks/1 remnant. Earlier 128 identified is category of attribution, not all impressions. Photo evidence not visually collated; external PDF screenshot returned 403; only textual extraction read.

sources.title: Transylvanian Diet Torda Jan 1568 religious preaching statute as translated in Balázs 2013
sources.verificationNote: Historical act quoted in modern English translation by Balazs (Introduction: Legislation in 1568 and 1571). Community chooses preacher and rejects compulsion; original Hungarian 16c manuscript/critical text not collated. No enumeration of four confessions in quoted wording; claim of first enumeration 1595 is historian's separate analysis.

sources.title: Transylvanian Diet Medgyes January 1570 restrictive statute on newly emerging heresies as quoted Balázs
sources.verificationNote: Balazs (The Limits of Tolerance) prints translated Medgyes law punishing new heresies; Jan 1571 Marosvasarhely act restores protection of preacher/listener with disciplinary exception. Original Hungarian primary text not independently collated.

sources.title: Mihály Balázs, Tolerant Country – Misunderstood Laws, Hungarian Historical Review 2(1)
sources.verificationNote: Scholarly original argument read Introduction/ Limits of Tolerance: 1568 and 1571 texts do not enumerate four received religions, first enumeration in 1595 (scholarly inference), 1570 repression of new heresies, 1568 separate provision on Wallachian bishop. Do not represent interpretation as words of 1568 law.
